iteration_notes: Initial policy tests rejected fixtures that accidentally included privateKey fields in public principal records; fixtures were corrected rather than relaxing schema validation.
Malformed Ed25519 root and principal keys are now rejected before persistence.
Policy validity uses a trusted clock dependency, not request-provided time.
limitations: Private HTTPS checkout remains unavailable without a noninteractive Git credential; exact remote blobs plus new sources were tested.
Bootstrap anchor distribution and production identity integration are not implemented.
No paid API, generation, deployment, publication or main merge.
